_comment: TIMELINE CONTENT — v1. This file drives the timeline cards, the journey map markers, and the progression path. To add a chapter (e.g. race track), append an object. To swap a placeholder illustration for a real photo later, set "photo" to a path like "assets/photos/my-photo.jpg" — the card renderer picks it up automatically, no code changes needed.
_photo_howto: Place photos in assets/photos/ (web-friendly: .jpg/.webp, < 300KB each). Then set the chapter's "photo" field. Captions go in "photoCaption".
